<subject>Re: May 3 Testimony Preparation AgriIndia/Grain Markets</subject>
<body>
Thanks Naksh.? We will incorporate the additions you mentioned below.? FarmCo Logistics (Oliver Chatura) will be presenting testimony on grain supply chain unbundling for the cooperatives. I agree that the large-scale commodity buyers should also provide supporting testimony.? Although we discussed this before, I did not get any definite commitments from the buyers that they would back such testimony - it might have been an oversight on my side.? Nonetheless, testimony from these buyers should cover the benefits from AgroTrade, GreenFields, CropUnion, HarvestPlus and others.? May I suggest that AgriIndia, as a major commodity trader itself, coordinate this effort with the other buying partners?

Additionally, I want all settlement parties to prepare beyond the testimony phase, as the hearings are set to start in just over a month.? We will need to allocate some time in late May for mock panels (assuming we secure panel hearings) and individual cross-examination drills.? Meanwhile, we also need to begin strategizing on direct cross-examination of the AgriCouncil/Trader Union parties (again, if we opt for full cross-examination of their settlement).? There is value in cross-examining the opposing settlement since it lacks thorough analysis, causes significant cost-shifting, and conflicts with the Agri Commission’s most viable options.? On the other hand, it might be wise to limit our cross-examination, particularly of Pranit, who tends to use the witness stand for grandstanding.? Something to consider.
</body>

Matthew: 
? 
Thanks for your memo.? Let me add the following comments.? There should be a chapter on the retail settlement with the key parties listed.? Rachit Dave and Tanish should be added to the chapter on impact on grain processors.? The Pushti Oommen Unbundling section where you list FarmCorp and AgriUnion was, I believe, originally supposed to include program benefits for the core aggregators as well, and you should add AgriIndia to the list for that Chapter. Let me know if you concur with my recollection.? Thanks, Naksh Dube
